external_integrations.name: VdoCipher
external_integrations.auth_method: API key in Authorization header: Bearer {VDOCIPHER_API_SECRET}
external_integrations.php_migration_note: Replace with direct VdoCipher PHP SDK or cURL calls to same REST API. VDOCIPHER_API_SECRET stays the same.

external_integrations.name: Google Play Integrity
external_integrations.auth_method: AES decryption key + RSA verification key
external_integrations.purpose: Verify that requests come from genuine, unmodified Android app builds
external_integrations.php_migration_note: Requires Google Play Integrity API client. PHP implementation using google/apiclient or direct JWT verification possible.

external_integrations.name: Supabase Auth
external_integrations.purpose: Email/phone OTP authentication, session management, JWT issuance
external_integrations.php_migration_note: Must be replaced with PHP session management (e.g., JWT with firebase/php-jwt or Laravel Sanctum). Auth users table must be migrated.

cron_jobs.name: trash-cleanup-daily
cron_jobs.purpose: Permanently delete users who have been in trash > retention_days (from trash_config), clean stale upload sessions
cron_jobs.php_migration_note: Replace with cPanel cron job calling PHP endpoint with equivalent logic

cron_jobs.name: video-daily-health
cron_jobs.purpose: Check all VdoCipher video health statuses, write video_daily_health_reports, create video_health_alerts for missing/errored videos
cron_jobs.php_migration_note: Replace with cPanel cron job calling PHP endpoint that queries VdoCipher API

webhooks.name: vdocipher-completion-webhook
webhooks.auth: HMAC-SHA256 signature in X-VdoCipher-Signature header, verified against VDOCIPHER_WEBHOOK_SECRET
webhooks.purpose: Receive video encoding completion notifications, update video_uploads.status
webhooks.php_migration_note: Replace endpoint with PHP webhook handler. Same HMAC verification logic.

push_notifications.note: No FCM, APNs, or Expo push notification secrets found in Edge Functions. Notifications are stored in public.notifications table as in-app only. Push delivery mechanism NOT detected in Supabase backend — may be handled client-side via Expo Push or not yet implemented.

email_service.purpose: Auth emails: confirmation, password reset, magic link
email_service.custom_smtp_configured: NOT_CONFIRMED — check Supabase dashboard Auth > SMTP settings
email_service.php_migration_note: Replace with PHPMailer or SMTP library for transactional emails
